title: The Last Stand at the Elder Tree
description: As the sky cracked with necrotic lightning, the party held the line beneath the Elder Tree. Steel, spellfire, and divine wrath collided in a battle that would be remembered across Valeria.

title: Siege of the Dwarven Gate
description: With the gates splintering and the war drums shaking the stone, the defenders made their stand in a desperate clash against overwhelming force.

title: The Dragonfall Vow
description: Before the ashes of a ruined battlefield, the heroes swore an oath to bring down every dragon that threatened Elandria, no matter the cost.
